properties.name: notification.redis.enabled
properties.description: Former Redis master switch. It was never read and is no longer bound.

deprecation.reason: Never read. Select the Redis store family with notification.store.type=redis.
Select the store family with notification.store.type (or notification.redis.idempotency.enabled).

properties.name: notification.idempotency.retry-after-failure
properties.description: Whether a request may retry under the same idempotency key after the previous attempt ended FAILED or REJECTED. When false, the failed record is kept and the retry gets HTTP 409 until the TTL elapses. Alias of failure-policy (true = RELEASE_ALL, false = KEEP); an explicit failure-policy wins.

deprecation.reason: Replaced by notification.idempotency.failure-policy, which also offers RELEASE_TRANSIENT.

properties.name: notification.idempotency.failure-policy
properties.description: What happens to an idempotency key after a failed send: RELEASE_ALL (retry dispatches again), KEEP (retry gets HTTP 409 until the TTL) or RELEASE_TRANSIENT (release only after a TRANSIENT failure; other failures are replayed). Unset follows retry-after-failure, which gives RELEASE_ALL.

properties.name: notification.idempotency.reject-key-reuse
properties.description: Refuse with HTTP 409 a request whose idempotency key was already used for a different request (different fingerprint). Records without a fingerprint are never compared.

properties.name: notification.idempotency.in-progress-timeout
properties.description: How long a send may hold a key IN_PROGRESS before a later request under the key settles it as FAILED (IN_PROGRESS_TIMEOUT, AMBIGUOUS), which is replayed and never released. Unset keeps answering HTTP 409 until the TTL.

properties.name: notification.retry.max-retry-after
properties.description: Longest provider retry hint (an HTTP Retry-After) the retry executor waits for. A longer hint stops the retries: the failure is returned at once and goes to the dead-letter store when one is configured. Defaults to notification.retry.max-delay; per-channel rules accept the same key under notification.retry.by-channel.<channel>, defaulting to that rule's max-delay.

values.description: In-process stores from notification-core. Default; state is per JVM.
